content.short: DeNet Storage is an infrastructure platform for decentralized storage.
content.description: Since its 2017 launch, DeNet Storage is a decentralized storage protocol that taps into global spare storage, removing reliance on centralized data centers. Built on blockchain and Web3 principles, it protects file security by fragmenting and encrypting data so only the owner can decrypt it. Privacy is a core focus, as it does not require personal data, with files stored across a resilient decentralized network. The architecture emphasizes privacy and resilience through a decentralized storage network.
